Package io.micronaut.security.context

Class MutableAttributeHolderSecurityContext

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.security.context.MutableAttributeHolderSecurityContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
SecurityContext
@Internal public class MutableAttributeHolderSecurityContext extends Object implements SecurityContext
Internal SecurityContext implementation backed by a MutableAttributeHolder.

It reads the authentication and token attributes written by SecurityFilter.

Since:
4.18.0
